from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import update

router = APIRouter(prefix="/crm/ai/tools")

class ToolCallPayload(BaseModel):
    name: str
    call_id: str
    arguments: dict

@router.post("/update-deal-stage")
async def update_crm_deal_stage(
    payload: ToolCallPayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_sales_rep),
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)
):
    if payload.name != "advance_deal":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Mismatched tool handler")

    deal_id = payload.arguments.get("deal_id")
    new_stage = payload.arguments.get("new_stage")
    probability = payload.arguments.get("probability", 50)

    stmt = (
        update(CrmDeal)
        .where(
            CrmDeal.id == deal_id,
            CrmDeal.tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id
        )
        .values(stage=new_stage, win_probability=probability)
        .returning(CrmDeal.id, CrmDeal.stage, CrmDeal.title)
    )
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    row = result.fetchone()
    if not row:
        await session.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Deal not found or unauthorized")

    await session.commit()
    return {
        "tool_call_id": payload.call_id,
        "deal_id": row.id,
        "updated_stage": row.stage,
        "title": row.title
    }
